verdict.rationale: Aider is a coding assistant that sends code to LLM providers, so a training-data privacy control is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training guarantee. The only related evidence is support for local models via Ollama. That is an adjacent model-selection feature relying on an external tool, not a documented control that prevents data being used for training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
